caption: The drawing depicts a hanging sign with two vertical black rods extending upward from either side, each topped with a knob. The sign itself is a vertically oriented, shield-like shape with two decorative round finials at the curves and a pointed central crest at the top, all in a muted brass or bronze tone. The upper portion of the sign features the text "J. PORTER" in large, gold capital letters on a dark, almost black background. The lower portion of the sign contains an oval-shaped painting. Within the oval, there is a figure seated on green ground, facing to the left. The figure appears to be a woman with brown hair, wearing a yellow garment with a floral pattern and a red skirt. She is holding a long staff topped with a small circular element in her right hand and a round, yellow shield with a floral design in her left hand. Nearby to the right, there is a depiction of a ship with sails colored in yellow tones. The overall color scheme of the painting is muted, with dominant earthy greens, browns, yellows, and reds; the imagery is set against a crackled, distressed white background. The composition is centered on an otherwise plain white field.
title: Tavern Sign: "J. Porter"
